meta.description: Operations manager with nine years turning messy processes into systems that hold up under pressure.

profile.name: Roane Purificacion
profile.headline: Data & Systems Specialist
profile.summary: Operations manager with nine years' experience across logistics and professional services. I take processes that grew by accident and rebuild them into systems people can actually follow — usually cutting the time they take in half. Comfortable owning a budget, a team, and the awkward conversation about why the old way isn't working.

bullets: Lead a team of 14 across scheduling, dispatch, and customer resolution.
Rebuilt the returns process end to end, cutting average handling time from 9 days to 4 and removing roughly £180k a year in avoidable cost.
Introduced weekly capacity planning that took on-time delivery from 87% to 96% within two quarters.
Own a £2.3m operating budget and report performance directly to the board each month.
Built the reporting suite the leadership team still runs on, replacing a fortnightly manual spreadsheet with a live dashboard.
Ran the workflow redesign for a 60-person service department, consulted through three rounds of staff feedback before rollout.
Trained 40+ colleagues on the new system, with adoption at 94% inside a month.
Coordinated inbound scheduling for four regional depots.
Cut stock discrepancies by 62% by introducing a simple daily reconciliation check.

items.name: Returns Process Rebuild
items.description: Mapped every step of a returns process that had grown unmanaged for six years, then rebuilt it around four decision points instead of nineteen. Cut handling time by more than half and gave the team a process they could explain to a new starter in ten minutes.

items.name: Live Capacity Dashboard
items.description: Replaced a fortnightly spreadsheet nobody trusted with a live view of depot capacity against booked volume. Planning meetings went from two hours of arguing about numbers to twenty minutes of deciding what to do about them.

items.name: Depot Onboarding Programme
items.description: Designed the onboarding used across all four depots after we found new starters were taking eleven weeks to reach full productivity. Structured it into three checkpoints with a named buddy at each. Time to productivity came down to six weeks.

bullets: Dissertation on lean methodology in small-scale distribution.
